method_text:
PDOs were dissociated into single cells and resuspended in cold 75% reduced growth factor 
Matrigel at 1500-4000 cells per 13-15ul per well in 384- well flat bottom plate format (Nunc). 
Subsequent top-up volume of respective media to a final volume of 50ul p er well. PDOs were 
grown from 6- 10 days in their respective media until small organoids begin to form at the 
beginning of their respective exponential growth phase. This is followed by media exchange to 
plain AIMV & stamping of respective compound plates using an automated liquid handler 
Bravo ST (Agilent). 72hr drug incubation during the exponential log phase of organoid growth. 
Breatheasy membrane seals (Sigma) were used throughout to ensure even evaporation rates 
across wells. Celltiterglo 3D (Promega) was used to measure cell viability, followed by an extra 
liquid handler mixing step for a more stable signal readout. Luminescence was detected using 
the Glomax Explorer plate reader (Promega).  
A panel of 100 compounds consisting of 85 FDA -approved drugs and 15 pipeline compounds 
targeting pathways frequently deregulated in HCC were tested using our 20 organoid 
representative panel ( Supplementary Table 3 ). S:B and Z’ factor (>0.5) obtained from 
minimum (100uM Bortezomib) and maximum (0.5% DMSO) controls were used as quality 
control (QC) measures. PDNTOs & PDNLOs with finite life span that did not meet the QC 
were excluded in the subsequent analysis. Norma lized percentage inhibition was used to 
generate AUC and IC50 on GraphPad Prism software v8. A fixed 10- point concentration with 
3-fold dilution at 100uM top concentration was used for all drugs to resolve difference between 
PDT-, NT- and NL-Orgs. Minimum of 2 independent runs were conducted and sh owed high 
concordance with each other (r>0.7, P<0.0001).

Dual-luciferase reporter assay 
To assess the promoter activity of NKD1 , luciferase assay was performed as previously 
described5. Primers for the construct of NKD1 were designed to amplify the β-catenin binding 
site and cloned into pGL3- basic vector. 239FT cells were co -transfected with pQCXIP empty 
vector, CTNNB1WT, CTNNB1T41A, or CTNNB1 S45P and Renilla plasmids using Lipofectamine 
2000 (Invitrogen). After 48 hours, cell lysates were harvested using Dual -Luciferase kit 
(Promega) according to the manufacturer’s protocol. Luciferase activity was calculated and 
normalized to Renilla control (Promega). The primers are listed under the CTAT table.
